text:
Mira: quick sync — Nimbus wants a private-offer structure tied to both committed spend and a hardware co-sell kick. need alignment on tiers + a short joint announce rhythm. anyone free to weigh in? :wave:
Alex: I can start. thinking simple 3-tier commit math + an optional hw kicker that triggers additional credits. keep it friendly for SI-led deals.
Sam: yes pls keep sales friction low. what does "kicker" look like operationally? credits on invoice or discount applied up-front?
Alex: draft: ```
Tier A: >=$500k commit -> 28% platform discount + $100k hw credit
Tier B: $200k-$499k -> 18% platform discount + $40k hw credit
Tier C: <$200k -> 10% platform discount, no hw credit
HW kicker: one-time credit applied at onboarding invoice; usable over 12 months.
```
Mira: that reads well. important: make renewal uplift path explicit so marketplace customers can graduate tiers. recommend 12m commit window with quarterly usage gates.
Claire: finance check — credits as an invoice credit are easiest for revenue recognition but we need SKU mapping for HW credits. also need minimum committed ARR to avoid churn risk. recommend $75k ARR floor for private-offer activation.
Sam: ok floor noted. for SI enablement, we should include a 30-day pre-launch partner enablement + test customer to prove install and billing flow.
Jordan: legal flags: term language for private offers should include explicit termination for non-payment and a clear clawback for hw credits if customer cancels <90 days. also need data-processing addendum if Nimbus wants co-marketing.
Mira: good call. let's make clawback a prorated repayment over the first 90 days. Jordan, can you draft a short clause we can reuse?
Jordan: will do. rough id: "HW credits are subject to repayment on early termination prorated to unused months; exceptions by mutual written consent."
Alex: ops/implementation note: marketplace private-offer flow needs these fields: offer_commit_amount, tier_label, hw_credit_amount, credit_redemption_period, renewal_anchor_date. will loop eng-catalog.
Mira: timeline proposal: 1) partner enablement & SI runbook week (T-30) 2) soft-launch with 1 pilot customer (T-14) 3) marketplace private-offer live + joint blog (T) 4) follow-up webinar + SI co-sell ramp (T+14). thoughts?
Sam: prefer T-7 for pilot instead of T-14 — gives quicker telemetry. otherwise +1.
Claire: add finance checkpoint at T-10 to confirm SKU mapping and invoice templates.
announce-bot: calendar event "Nimbus Private Offer Launch — cross-functional sync" created for T-30 to T+14 cadence.
Mira: next steps: Jordan to drop legal clause, Claire to confirm SKU mapping, Alex to file offer spec for eng-catalog, Sam to line up pilot customer. i'll consolidate and share ADO checklist by EOD. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks — i'll ping potential pilot (Acme) today.
Alex: filing spec now, will tag eng-catalog and eng-billing.
Jordan: uploading clause draft in this thread shortly.
Mira: perfect — meeting notes + checklist incoming. thanks all! :rocket:
